overall_assessment.summary: The refactored pipeline performs well on the sampled benchmark cases, especially for scope adherence, constrained itinerary generation, revision retention, and out-of-scope refusal handling. The main remaining issue observed in the sampled run is incomplete fulfillment on one in-scope place query that returned fewer items than requested.
